enum_value: application.study_level.MASTER — required for a Master policy to apply.
collection: undergraduate_degrees — required to evaluate qualifying undergraduate credentials for Master admission.
collection: additional_master_level_achievements — required to retain individual DQR-7/Master-level achievements contributing to grade compensation.
fact: qualification.completed — required on undergraduate_degrees to establish completion of the qualifying degree.
fact: qualification.subject_relationship_to_program — required to distinguish computer-science/informatics/similar degrees from different-subject degrees.
enum_value: qualification.subject_relationship_to_program.MATCH — identifies a computer-science, informatics, or similar qualifying degree.
enum_value: qualification.subject_relationship_to_program.DIFFERENT_SUBJECT — identifies the special different-subject admission route.
enum_value: qualification.subject_relationship_to_program.UNCERTAIN — preserves unresolved subject-area classification for review.
fact: qualification.degree_certificate_proven — required to establish that the degree certificate or diploma is available.
fact: qualification.transcript_proven — required to establish that the Transcript of Records is available.
fact: qualification.successful_completion_proven — required because successful completion must be evident beyond doubt.
fact: qualification.final_grade_proven — required because the overall final grade must be evident beyond doubt.
fact: qualification.ects_assessed_proven — required because ECTS, including assessment from standard duration where applicable, must be established.
fact: qualification.ects_assessed — required to store ECTS stated or derived from six-month full-time standard-study periods.
fact: qualification.final_grade_category — required to represent whether the final grade meets the stated 3.5 threshold.
enum_value: qualification.final_grade_category.AT_LEAST_SATISFACTORY_3_5 — represents a final grade of satisfactory (3.5) or better.
enum_value: qualification.final_grade_category.BELOW_SATISFACTORY_3_5 — represents a final grade below the stated minimum.
fact: qualification.award_context — required to distinguish domestic recognition assessment from foreign Anabin assessment.
enum_value: qualification.award_context.DOMESTIC — identifies a domestic undergraduate award.
enum_value: qualification.award_context.FOREIGN — identifies an undergraduate award obtained abroad.
fact: qualification.awarding_institution_state_recognized — required for the state/state-recognized-university criterion for domestic awards.
fact: qualification.anabin_institution_status — required for Anabin classification of the foreign awarding institution.
fact: qualification.anabin_qualification_status — required for Anabin classification of the specific foreign qualification.
enum_value: qualification.anabin_institution_status.H_PLUS — required to represent an Anabin H+ institution classification.
enum_value: qualification.anabin_institution_status.H_PLUS_MINUS — required to represent an Anabin H+/- institution classification requiring the prescribed IU decision process.
enum_value: qualification.anabin_institution_status.H_MINUS — required to represent an Anabin H- institution classification that excludes admission.
enum_value: qualification.anabin_institution_status.UNLISTED — required to represent an institution absent from Anabin and requiring consultation.
enum_value: qualification.anabin_qualification_status.H_PLUS — required to represent an Anabin H+ specific-qualification classification.
enum_value: qualification.anabin_qualification_status.H_PLUS_MINUS — required to represent an Anabin H+/- specific-qualification classification requiring the prescribed IU decision process.
enum_value: qualification.anabin_qualification_status.H_MINUS — required to represent an Anabin H- specific-qualification classification that excludes admission.
fact: applicant.native_english_speaker — required to determine whether the English-proof requirement applies.
fact: application.english_b2_proof_submitted_before_start — required to establish timely submission before study start.
fact: application.english_b2_proof_valid — required to record validated B2-or-higher proof under the stated certificate, score/grade, and five-year limits.
fact: qualification.relevant_dqr7_achievements_proven — required to establish proven relevant DQR-7/equivalent achievements for grade compensation.
fact: qualification.relevant_dqr7_achievements_ects_total — required to store the aggregated proven ECTS-equivalent scope of relevant DQR-7 achievements.
fact: qualification.program_focus_ects_proven — required to establish evidence for prior coursework in the intended program focus area.
fact: qualification.program_focus_ects_total — required to store the aggregated ECTS total in the intended program focus area.
fact: application.master_program_variant_ects — required to limit the different-subject entrance-examination route to the 120-ECTS variant.
fact: application.master_program_is_consecutive — required to limit the entrance-examination route to consecutive Master programs.
fact: qualification.master_entrance_exam_two_subject_courses_proven — required to establish completion of the two prescribed subject-specific courses.
fact: qualification.master_entrance_exam_ects — required to establish the stated 10-ECTS scope of the Master entrance examination.
fact: qualification.master_entrance_exam_passed_within_one_year — required to establish that both examination courses were passed within one year.
rule_id: MASTER_CS_RELEVANT_UNDERGRADUATE_STANDARD — required for the standard relevant-undergraduate-degree admission path.
rule_id: MASTER_CS_DQR7_GRADE_COMPENSATION — required for the below-minimum-grade DQR-7 compensation path.
rule_id: MASTER_CS_DIFFERENT_SUBJECT_FOCUS_AREA — required for different-subject admission based on 30 ECTS in the intended focus area.
rule_id: MASTER_CS_DIFFERENT_SUBJECT_ENTRANCE_EXAMINATION — required for different-subject admission after the Master entrance examination.
reason_code: FOREIGN_UNDERGRADUATE_CREDENTIAL_H_MINUS — required to explain rejection where an Anabin institution or qualification classification is H-.
reason_code: FOREIGN_UNDERGRADUATE_CREDENTIAL_DECISION_REQUIRED — required to explain manual review for H+/- or unlisted foreign-credential cases.
reason_code: MASTER_CS_RELEVANT_UNDERGRADUATE_STANDARD_ACCESS — required to explain standard access through a relevant qualifying undergraduate degree.
reason_code: MASTER_CS_STANDARD_ADMISSION_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE — required to explain incomplete evidence for the standard academic route.
reason_code: MASTER_CS_STANDARD_ADMISSION_REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET — required to explain failure of the standard academic route.
reason_code: MASTER_CS_DQR7_GRADE_COMPENSATION_ACCESS — required to explain access through proven relevant DQR-7 compensation achievements.
reason_code: MASTER_CS_DQR7_COMPENSATION_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE — required to explain incomplete evidence for the DQR-7 compensation route.
reason_code: MASTER_CS_DQR7_COMPENSATION_REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET — required to explain failure of the DQR-7 compensation route.
reason_code: MASTER_CS_FOCUS_AREA_30_ECTS_ACCESS — required to explain different-subject access based on 30 proven focus-area ECTS.
reason_code: MASTER_CS_FOCUS_AREA_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE — required to explain incomplete focus-area waiver evidence.
reason_code: MASTER_CS_FOCUS_AREA_REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET — required to explain failure of the focus-area waiver route.
reason_code: MASTER_CS_ENTRANCE_EXAMINATION_ACCESS — required to explain different-subject access after passing the stated Master entrance examination.
reason_code: MASTER_CS_ENTRANCE_EXAMINATION_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE — required to explain incomplete Master entrance-examination evidence.
reason_code: MASTER_CS_ENTRANCE_EXAMINATION_REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET — required to explain failure of the Master entrance-examination route.
